title: Resolution setting how property tax burden splits across classes
summary: This resolution updates the formula the City Council certifies to the state for dividing the Fiscal 2027 property tax levy among the four classes of real property, following a 2026 state law change. It applies a 0.3 percent cap on increases for Classes 1 and 2, shifting the excess share onto Classes 3 and 4. The measure replaces a version adopted on June 30, 2026 and is tied to a companion resolution the Council will also vote on November 12, 2026.
